context:
In plain words (rewritten 11:42 CST Nov 15, after your note "sxplain this more simply and what we r waiting on"): You told us to skip every CI job when a push to main only changes the records file. We built it to skip fewer jobs than that, because skipping the rest would weaken a safety check on CI itself. That version is already live (merged 20:42 CST Nov 14). We do not know yet how much time it saves: one full run took 44 min 32 s, and one run is not enough to say. WE ARE WAITING ON YOU, nothing else: press Keep (leave it as built, no new work) or Overrule (we widen it to every job; a lane loosens that safety check and it gets a fresh review). The coordinator does not recommend Overrule before the list of steps that read the records file exists.

Goal: you see and can overrule every pick a session takes for you ("Nothing can't be undone don't wait on me", your 20:18 CST Nov 14 words; and your 00:11 CST Nov 15 question where the picks went).
Problem (rule): you chose c ("every job") knowingly. The coordinator's own pick of 17:15 CST narrowed the build, undoable, and you had not been told. #3426 merged with the narrower gate at 20:42:52 CST Nov 14. Going wider relaxes a pin (a guard change), so it needs your word.
Based on (ruling): own-830-c-ci-scope-green-before-head, and the step ci-scope-skips-records-only-push (the coordinator's hand-in at 18:46 CST: 34 steps stay unconditioned; 3 steps always and 3 conditional steps read docs/records.md; 6 unknown; the Windows guard read by static trace only; gain unmeasured, one full run 44 min 32 s after the records step, n=1). Relayed; triage read no code or record.
Departs from: main - all jobs run on every push; the merged build skips part of them on a records-only push, less than you chose.
Meanwhile: the pick stands and the work under it continues. Undo: say Overrule; a lane widens the gate. An answer of Keep closes this with no act.
TAKEN FOR YOU: the build of your item 830 c (skip CI on a push that changes only docs/records.md after a fully green head) does less than the "every job" you chose: it gates only what main already scopes by `code`, plus the merge, rest and mutation-report jobs, and leaves the unconditioned md-reading steps and the Windows guard job ungated unless traced safe. Taken by coordinator (session_013NEJL1gw6EdrSyvHkTUEx6) at 17:15 CST Nov 14.
